dc RISK 1 customer concentration: 10-K Item 1A (Risks Related to Our Global Operating Business) 'A significant amount of our revenue stems from a limited number of partners and distributors and we have a concentration of sales to customers who purchase directly or indirectly from us'; direct customers FY2026 22% and 14%, Q2 FY2027 one at 16%, H1 FY2027 three at 16/15/13 = 44%; indirect customers (CSPs, AI labs) some above 10% (sources pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826).

dc RISK 2 supply and demand mismatch: 10-K Item 1A (Risks Related to Demand, Supply, and Manufacturing) 'Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately has led and could lead to mismatches between supply and demand'; supply and capacity commitments rose from 119 to 279 USD B in one quarter, inventory 31.6 USD B, provisions 985 USD M in Q2 FY2027 and a 4.5 USD B H20 charge in Q1 FY2026 (pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826).

dc RISK 3 third-party manufacturing: 10-K Item 1A (Demand, Supply, and Manufacturing) 'Dependency on third-party suppliers and their technology to manufacture, assemble, test, or package our products reduces our control over product quantity and quality, manufacturing yields, and product delivery schedules'; the 10-K says the supply chain is mainly concentrated in Asia and complex product transitions (Blackwell Ultra, Rubin on a one-year cadence) have caused and may cause delays (pf_10k_20260225, Item 7 'Recent Developments').

dc RISK 4 export controls and China: 10-K Item 1A (Regulatory, Legal, Our Stock and Other Matters) 'We are subject to complex laws, rules, regulations, and political and other actions, including restrictions on the export of our products'; H20 licence requirement April 2025 caused a 4.5 USD B charge; H200 licences since February 2026 for small amounts, restricted by the PRC government; the Q3 FY2027 outlook assumes no China Data Center compute revenue; China incl. Hong Kong HQ revenue 7.9 USD B in Q2 FY2027, mostly not Data Center (pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826).

dc RISK 5 competition and open-source models: 10-K Item 1A (Risks Related to Our Industry and Markets) 'Competition could adversely impact our market share and financial results'; Item 7 adds that rising open-source foundation models, if deployed on competitors' platforms, could reduce demand for NVIDIA products (pf_10k_20260225). Named competitors and their numbers: gather_field.

dc RISK 6 counterparty, financing and circularity: 10-K Item 1A (Global Operating Business) 'Commercial arrangements expose us to counterparty risks'; 10-K: 17.5 USD B invested in private companies and infrastructure funds in FY2026, including AI model makers that buy NVIDIA products directly or through CSPs, and 3.5 USD B land/power/shell guarantees; since then equity investments 99 USD B, SB Energy guarantees capped at 105 USD B (OpenAI affiliate tenant, first phase fiscal 2029) and 36 USD B AI cloud agreements (pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826, nm_sec_8k_20260817).

dc RISK 7 results, margin and cash conversion: 10-K Item 1A (Global Operating Business) 'Our operating results have in the past fluctuated and may in the future fluctuate'; gross margin is guided down from 75.0% to 74.0% in Q3 and 71%-72% in Q4 FY2027, and operating cash flow fell to 24.1 USD B in Q2 FY2027 (net income 59.7 USD B incl. 7.8 USD B equity-security gains) on receivables (days sales outstanding 60 vs 45) and inventory (pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826, pf_rel_20260826_2).

dc RISK 8 investments and acquisitions: 10-K Item 1A (Global Operating Business) 'We may not be able to realize the potential benefits of business investments or acquisitions'; GAAP income includes unrealized equity-security gains (15.9 + 7.8 USD B in H1 FY2027) that can reverse, non-marketable equity securities are 51.2 USD B, 36.9 USD B of marketable equity is under lock-up, the Groq licence booked 14.4 USD B of goodwill, and the Hugging Face agreement is about 11.9 USD B (pf_10k_20260225, pf_10q_20260826, rp_8k_hf_2026_09).
